name: code-tracer
description: Side pane of every code change in the session, tied to the code: file and lines, the diff hunk, the agent that made it, its stated why, the test run that covered it, and a signed ambition sum with its signals; marks files two agents changed. No model calls unless the opt-in reflector is on.

reflector.title: Reflector
reflector.description: After each main-loop turn, one Haiku call reviews the weak changes of the session and lists one improvement per change under it; open items are fed to the next step. Off: no model calls at all. `/code-tracer reflect` runs one review on demand either way.
